reader_summary.overview: In November 2025, I hosted a fireside chat at Columbia University with Deepak Gurnani, founder of Versor Investments. Deepak spent two decades at Investcorp, where he built and led the firm’s hedge fund division. In 2013, he stepped away to found Versor with a singular goal: to build a research-driven quantitative firm focused on leveraging alternative data.

key_points.text: In November 2025, I hosted a fireside chat at Columbia University with Deepak Gurnani, founder of Versor Investments.
This conversation is a continuation of the story we began on Odds on Open with Nishant Gurnani and DeWayne Louis, two of Versor’s partners.
In that episode, we explored the systematic strategies that Versor runs.
